ALL NEEDED WIRING CONNECTIONS ARE CONVIENENTLY LOCATED INSIDE THE GAME FOR THIS APPLICATION. @ THE COIN DOOR CAN ACCCOMMODATE THE FOLLOWING VALIDATORS: HOLE POSITION#1 Mars 2000 series (FORWARD-MOST POSITION) HOLE POSITION#2 Mars 2000 series DBV45 (JCM) HOLE POSITION #3 CURRENTLY NOT USED HOLE POSITION #4 DsI0o1* *The back flange on the chute can be removed for hold position #4. If the flange is not removed, it may interfere with the back of the cabinent. The frame and cashbox enclosure on this coindoor has been modified to accomodate a Mars 2000 series upstacker. A 2000 series stacker can be added by simply removing the top two entry door and replacing it with a one entry door with a cut-out for a stacker. This one entry door can be ordered through Coin Controls or one of Coin Controls autherized distributors. The part number is 91-4000-01. The Mars stacker can be obtained through an autherized Mars distibutor.
